sara: Heads up — prod p99 spike on gpu-pool-b around 07:40 UTC. Dashboard shows selector flipping between flash_attn_v2 and gemm_fallback for medium-seq jobs (seq ~ 320-400). KV hit-rate dropped ~12% around the same window :warning:

alex: I see it. Driver event stream shows a new workspace-query path after the 12.4.1 driver push to that rack. Selector logs: `workspace_needed=true` for flash_attn_v2 -> fallback. No code change on our side.

matt: repro'd locally on g5x-canary. Short log excerpt from profiler:```
[profiling] seq=360 batch=6 kernel=flash_attn_v2 time=2.2ms workspace_check=FAIL
[profiling] seq=360 batch=6 kernel=gemm_fallback time=4.1ms
[telemetry] kv_hit=0.78 -> 0.66 after flip
```

perf-bot: quick summary: selector switched because `workspace_size()` returned larger-than-expected on ~30% of launches. Batch effective size dropped (avg 8 -> 4) causing higher p99 and more KV fetches. Attached flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/2071234567 (link)

jamie: two quick mitigation ideas: 1) temporary selector override to prefer legacy flash_attn_v1 when seq in [128,512], or 2) increase batcher max_delay_ms to allow batches to reform after transient workspace failures. Config example to push to canary:```
batcher.max_batch_size=8
batcher.max_delay_ms=10
selector.prefer_flash_v1=true
```

sara: i'm going to pin the driver on kernel hosts in pool-b back to 12.3.x for now and roll a selector-override canary to 10% of traffic. Opening incident ticket and will ping infra. @alex can you collect nvidia-smi + kernel logs from host-17 and host-23?

alex: grabbing logs now. snippets show fragmentation + a process on host-17 leaking small pinned allocations (~120 MiB churn). `nvidia-smi vgpu` shows GPU-MEM usage oscillating. Might be noisy-tenant causing workspace fragmentation.

matt: note — if this is fragmentation rather than real workspace requirement, we should adjust selector heuristic to tolerate transient workspace failures (treat 1-2 consecutive fails as soft-fail, not immediate fallback). I'll prototype selector change and run perf harness.

deploy-bot: deployment started -> canary-selector-override @ 10% (sha: a1b2c3d). Watch logs in #eng-runtime-canaries.

sara: thanks. i'll update the incident ticket with the perf-bot findings and next steps: rollback driver on affected hosts, run selector soft-fail patch in canary, and keep monitoring KV hit-rate + batch size histograms.

jamie: filing vendor bug with NVIDIA too — sending profiler dumps and workspace-query traces.

alex: uploaded `nvidia-smi` + dmesg + allocator traces to /s3/perf/2071234567. host-17 shows frequent CUDA_PAGE_FAULT events around spike window.

matt: TL;DR — probable driver/fragmentation-triggered selector flip causing batching collapse and KV thrash. Mitigations: driver rollback, selector soft-fail, canary with prefer_flash_v1. We'll reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
